title: EventCompletedEvent
description: Published by the Events service when an event is marked complete (attendance applied or manual completion). Added 2026-08-07 for Unit 7's staged fan-out (DL4): instead of one AttendanceRecorded per attendee, Events emits ONE lightweight EventCompleted; Contributions & Scoring reads the event + earner lists back from Events (GET /events/{eventId}) and fans out per-earner internally, so the user's 'mark complete' click never waits on point-awarding (DL3). Each earner entry carries the earner's ROLE stamped at completion time (DL8) so Contributions needs no role projection. `groupId` null = community-wide (Contributions splits equally across the earner's groups). Bundled in the Unit 7 coordinated redeploy; supersedes per-attendee award publication.

eventDate.description: ISO date the event occurred; sets the scoring quarter (DL11)

groupId.description: The event's group, or null for community-wide (Contributions applies the equal-distribution split)
